## raise and rescue

`raise ArgumentError, "bad"` throws. `begin...rescue...ensure...end` handles and cleans up. Rescue specific classes — bare `rescue` catches `StandardError`.

## Custom errors

Subclass `StandardError` for domain failures callers may want to handle. Reserve `Exception` subclasses for truly fatal cases.

## retry

`retry` re-enters the `begin` block — useful for flaky IO with a counter. Don't infinite-loop.

blocks.code:
class NotFound < StandardError; end

def find(id)
  raise NotFound, "id=#{id}" if id.nil?
  { id: id }
end

begin
  find(nil)
rescue NotFound => e
  puts "handled: #{e.message}"
ensure
  puts "cleanup"
end
